fact: The MIS-PTMP produced and reconciled payment lists shared with mobile payment operators, and the registry and targeting mechanisms were made available to other social programmes, with the PMT targeting used by the CMU's Régime d'Assistance Médicale, while the MIS-PTMP data was to migrate to the RSU after quality assurance in 2024.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report, Côte d'Ivoire Productive Social Safety Net Project (ICR00006568)
